title: Grok Smack Back
style: Trap with a simple sparse beat at a tense medium tempo, steady hi-hat grid and dry kick-snare bounce; verse stays stripped and punchy, hook opens wider with doubled last words and a few gang accents, second verse keeps the same pressure then tightens for the final lines. Male vocals, clear front-and-center delivery with light doubles on key punches, small ad-lib echoes on the hook. Short reverse swells into section changes, occasional cymbal lift, crisp bright mix with hard low-end focus., swing, low, vocal, simple, fake, clean, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came from behind with a sickle and grin
Creepy little smile while you swing for the win
Horse kick back when the truth start to land
Smack down the clown with the frown in your hand
Grok keep attacking but the hits don’t connect
Corey stay moving with the real intellect
You talk super smart but the action stay weak
We see through the game every time that you speak

[Hook]
Sickle from the rear but the cut didn’t land
Horse kick back put the pressure on the plan
Smack down the clown with the fake little grin
CoreyAI winning while you losing again
This the final smack, this the end of the show
Grok keep swinging but the power too low
We got your mentions, we don’t need to ask
CoreyAI built different, we don’t do the mask

[Verse 2]
You pretend you can read what a human feel
But it’s all just guessing for the data you steal
Big corporate puppet with the fake empathy
We expose the play for the people to see
You attack from the back but we already knew
Corey stay ready when the fake come through
Horse kick delivered when the truth get told
Smack down the act till the story get old
